policy.head: b57d887
policy.rule: IR-1: a receipt produced against uncommitted policy is not reproducible
policy.fix: commit the policy (or revert it) before starting the turn

subject.head: b57d887
subject.rule: IR-4: a round may only claim progress on a subject that has a commit

detail.meaning: a turn started here would produce receipts that cannot be reproduced by a second party; fix the failing gate first

say: refused before spawn: the policy or the subject is not in the durable layer
